王野回到院子，可是胡同里可热闹了。别看现在是半夜了，可是看热闹的可不少，王野院子里的人也跟了出来。王野心想：“看来人民看热闹的习惯不是后世独有的，这个时代就也是一样。”

王野跟父母报过平安后又回到了那个院子。现在这个院子已经被包围起来了。王野进入院子，看见吴志强正在指挥着搜查整个院子。

王野上前给吴志强点了一根烟说：“师父，怎么样有收获吗？”

吴志强说：“屁的收获，也不知道这帮混蛋藏哪儿了，咱们的人所有的屋子都搜过了，除了他们身上的武器什么有用的东西都没有。”

王野觉得这不可能，七个人的团队。不可能什么都没有，王野放出精神力扫过所有屋子。就连炕下面都扫了，什么都没有，全是正常的居家用品。

王野还不信邪了，一间一间的搜索，在耳房边上的地窖里王野发现了猫腻。这里有一个暗室，暗室的入口居然在水缸里。这个水缸只有上半截是水，而且还是腌菜汤。

王野对吴志强说：“师父我也去看看，人多力量大吗？”

吴志强气呼呼的说：“去吧，找不到也别费劲了，好好审审这几个王八蛋，要是审不出来，老子扒了这个院子，我挖地三尺就不信找不到。”

看着吴志强的样子，王野赶紧跑了，王野拿着个小棍子在各个屋子里敲敲打打。没一会儿就进入了地窖，王野一进去就有股难闻的味道。捂着鼻子在里面敲敲打打。没一会儿王野就喊，来俩人给我把这个缸抬起来。其实王野自己就可以搬走，但是这玩意儿太难闻了。

吴志强也捂着鼻子进了地窖好奇的问：“小野是有什么发现吗？”

王野说：“师父，你看谁家地窖里的腌菜缸臭了都不清理呀，这里绝对有猫腻。”

吴志强气呼呼的喊道：“你们这帮小兔崽子，就因为臭就不好好搜查。看我回去不修理你们。”

来了两个开始用力搬动水缸，可是两人使出吃奶的劲儿水缸纹丝不动。又上了两个人还是搬不动。

王野围着水缸看了一会儿说：“把里面的水掏出来。”

没一会儿就有人拿着瓢和桶进来了。几人合作很快缸里的水就被掏干净了。掏水的兄弟立刻喊道：“科长，这个缸有夹层。”

吴志强上前看了一眼说：“砸开。”

立刻有人拿着大棍子把缸底砸破。一个向下的通道出现在众人眼前。

“来人下去看看。”吴志强命令道，接着一个瘦小的汉子就被绳子送了下去。

下去没一会儿汉子就喊：“科长下面是个暗室，没有危险。”

“再下去一个人，把下面的东西弄上来。”命令完吴志强和王野就出了地窖。

接下来就是一顿忙活，暗室的东西被不停的运了上来，摆在了院子里。经过一个多小时的运送才把暗室搬空。王野上前一看东西是真多。

两部电台，二十五支长枪，二十支手枪，各种子弹十五箱。黄金一箱，各种票据一袋子，大黑十有三万多，还有一万多漂亮币。

这些王野都不吃惊后面的东西才是吓人呢，手雷有足足五箱，炸药包三箱，最吓人的是他们还有一门迫击炮，和两箱炮弹。剩下的桌椅都是军用的，太踏马奢侈了，全都是可以折叠的。这东西应该都是漂亮国的标配。

王野小声的问：“师父，这些是不是都得上交？”

吴志强说：“那肯定呀，不上交会死人的。”

王野心想：“这踏马不是亏了吗，不行废了这么大劲王野能一点好处没有，这个亏不能吃。”

王野又偷偷的问：“师父，那这个院子呢。”

Wang Ye returned to the yard, but the alley was bustling.Even though it was midnight, there were many people watching the excitement, and people from Wang Ye's courtyard also followed.Wang Ye thought: "It seems that people's habit of watching the excitement is not unique to later generations. It is the same in this era."

Wang Ye returned to the yard after reporting to his parents that he was safe.The yard is now surrounded.Wang Ye entered the yard and saw Wu Zhiqiang directing a search of the entire yard.

Wang Ye stepped forward and lit a cigarette for Wu Zhiqiang and said, "Master, have you gained anything from this?"

Wu Zhiqiang said: "What a harvest, I don't know where these bastards are hiding. Our people have searched all the houses, and there is nothing useful except the weapons on them."

Wang Ye thinks this is impossible, a team of seven people.There was no way there was nothing. Wang Ye released his mental power and swept through all the rooms.Even the underside of the kang was swept, and there was nothing there. They were all normal household items.

Wang Ye still didn't believe it, so he searched one room after another, and found something fishy in the cellar next to the penthouse.There is a darkroom here, and the entrance to the darkroom is actually in the water tank.Only the upper half of this water tank is filled with water, and it is also filled with pickle soup.

Wang Ye said to Wu Zhiqiang: "Master, let me go and have a look. Is there more power in numbers?"

Wu Zhiqiang said angrily: "Go ahead, don't bother if you can't find them. Just interrogate these bastards carefully. If they can't be found out, I'll dig up this yard. I'll dig three feet into the ground and I won't believe they can't be found."

Seeing Wu Zhiqiang's appearance, Wang Ye ran away quickly. Wang Ye took a small stick and beat it in various rooms.After a while, Wang Ye entered the cellar. As soon as Wang Ye entered, there was an unpleasant smell.He held his nose and knocked inside.After a while, Wang Ye shouted, "Come and help me lift this tank."In fact, Wang Ye could move it by himself, but this stuff smells too bad.

Wu Zhiqiang also covered his nose and entered the cellar and asked curiously: "Did Xiaoye discover anything?"

Wang Ye said: "Master, look at someone who doesn't clean the pickle vat in their cellar when it smells bad. There is definitely something fishy here."

Wu Zhiqiang shouted angrily: "You little bastards, you won't search properly just because it smells bad. See if I don't fix you when I get back."

Two people came and started to move the water tank with all their strength, but the water tank didn't move at all with all their strength.Two more people got on it and still couldn't move it.

Wang Ye looked around the water tank for a while and said, "Take out the water inside."

Soon someone came in with a ladle and bucket.With the cooperation of several people, the water in the tank was quickly drained out.The brother who was collecting water immediately shouted: "Section Chief, this tank has a mezzanine."

Wu Zhiqiang stepped forward, took a look and said, "Smash it open."

Immediately, someone took a big stick and smashed the bottom of the tank.A downward passage appeared in front of everyone.

"Someone come down and take a look." Wu Zhiqiang ordered, and then a thin man was sent down by a rope.

Not long after we got down, the man shouted: "There is a dark room below the section chief. There is no danger."

"One more person goes down and brings up the things below." After giving the order, Wu Zhiqiang and Wang Ye left the cellar.

What followed was a busy day of work. Things from the darkroom were constantly brought up and placed in the yard.It took more than an hour of transportation to empty the darkroom.Wang Ye stepped forward and saw that there were so many things.

Two radios, twenty-five long guns, twenty pistols, and fifteen boxes of various bullets.There is a box of gold, a bag of various bills, more than 30,000 big black coins, and more than 10,000 beautiful coins.

These Wang Ye were not surprised. What was behind them was scary. There were five boxes of grenades and three boxes of explosives. The most frightening thing was that they also had a mortar and two boxes of artillery shells.The remaining tables and chairs are all military-style, which is too luxurious, and they are all foldable.This thing should be standard equipment in beautiful countries.

Wang Ye asked in a low voice: "Master, do I have to hand in all of these?"

Wu Zhiqiang said: "That's for sure. If you don't hand it over, someone will die."

Wang Ye thought: "Isn't it a loss to step on the horse? It's no good to waste such great strength. Wang Ye can do no good. This loss cannot be taken."

Wang Ye asked secretly: "Master, what about this courtyard?"
